description: This node's address book and the peers it has heard of (the shadow), searched by text (q; empty means everything), as a bounded list of {key: publicKey, label}; a label's book says whether the book holds them. It also starts one network search across the relays if none is in flight; its rows land in the shadow, so asking again finds them. selfTail is the tail of this node's own key, or null.
